name: 02215 · Boston, MA
findings: ZIP 02215 (Boston) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02215 (Boston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02215 (Boston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 research and think tank organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do research and think tank organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02215 (Boston) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 1 religious organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.
